community: Remote & backcountry, Peace River Regional District

description.value: A 50-site BC Parks campground on Gwillim Lake in Northern BC, running from late May through early September with potable water and washrooms. Road surface to camp is unconfirmed, so cyclists should check access conditions before routing here.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record identifies this as a BC Parks campground (tourism=camp_site) with capacity 50, operated under contract by Sandstorm North Contracting, and the website URL resolves to the official BC Parks page for Gwillim Lake Park. However, the fetched website content captured only the site-wide navigation menu rather than the park-specific detail page, so no campground amenity details (toilets, water, etc.) can be confirmed from the website. OSM tags supply fee=yes, internet_access=no, and an operator email, but per rules these are not treated as authoritative for amenity claims without website corroboration.
concerns: Website fetch captured only the site-wide BC Parks navigation menu, not the Gwillim Lake park detail page; all amenity fields remain unverifiable from website content.
All subpage probes returned 404, suggesting the BC Parks site structure may have changed since the URL was recorded.
Operator email (sandstormnorth@gmail.com) is a personal Gmail address for a contracting company, not a BC Parks address; contact details may be for the contractor rather than the park directly.
No phone number or civic address is present in OSM.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, fee-based BC Parks campground with 50 sites at a confirmed location in northern BC; the looks_closed flag is false and no closure signals are present.
enrichment_extras.notes: OSM tag internet_access=no noted but not confirmed via website per rules; left as null in amenities.
